How to be successful in this role: - 10+ years of experience in GTM Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related function, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. - Deep experience with Top-of-Funnel and lead-to-account operations, including areas such as lead routing, account assignment, territory management, seller coverage, and AE operating models. - An investigative mindset with a demonstrated ability to dig beneath surface-level symptoms, connect insights across data, systems, processes, and field feedback, and identify the root cause of complex GTM problems. - A hands-on operating style. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective. We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:ce9b21f9-4a9.title: Ads Quality Rater - Farsi (Turkey)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:ce9b21f9-4a9.description: Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join! As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords. You will review ads in both English and Farsi This role is great for people who: - Surf the internet daily - Use major search engines frequently - Know what people want based on a few keywords - Enjoy researching topics online - Want a flexible and fun side job Project Details Job Title: Ads Quality Rater - Farsi (Turkey) Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $5 per hour) Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Turkey Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week. Start Date: ASAP Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed Project Duration: Long-term Note: - Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process. Recruitment Process - There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not. - Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process. IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity checks to ensure that everyone who makes the team is real, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid any misunderstandings, do not use IP masking programs (such as VPNs).
